spans.s: (I)--a राक्षस and a son of खशा. As he wanted to eat his own mother, he got the name of यक्ष; of four hands and four feet, a fearful figure wandering in the night in search of prey; took the form of Vasuruci and lived with the apsaras क्रथुस्थला in Nandana; she bore him a son रजतनाभ; went home in the हिमालयस् with the son, when क्रथुस्थला came to know of his birth as a राक्षस. Br.
